blocks.text: Helpdesk ticket triage bot, technical design

This is the working cut for WTS-4502 on April 4, 2023. Carla Nguyen asked for a written bound after the current path (Jira Service Management on jira-01.whetstone.internal, one queue, mean first response 2.7 hours) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host helpdesk.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on vendor chatbot auto-close, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Ship a Python classifier that tags password, printer, VPN, and mailbox queues. Human still assigns. Reject the $9.7k vendor chatbot that wanted to close tickets without Carla in the loop. I am not restating a hallway yes. vendor chatbot auto-close is out because Pilot closed 41 tickets in 3 days, 12 of them were still broken. Carla will not give a bot close rights. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at users=208, labels=4, conf=0.72, cost=9.7, closed=41, broken=12, hours=2.7, cut=31.4. Sibling tickets WTS-TDD-2023-018 and WTS-4502-QA. I will not reopen vendor chatbot auto-close in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
Decision for leadership

blocks.text: Ship a Python classifier that tags password, printer, VPN, and mailbox queues. Human still assigns. Reject the $9.7k vendor chatbot that wanted to close tickets without Carla in the loop.

Ticket WTS-4502 names the pull. If those numbers moved after April 4, 2023, update this file in review, do not 'correct' them in Slack.
